titulo_fr: Un article qui propose des solutions : Repérer les informations

intro: It relates a social problem to its causes, proposals and possible limits. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It relates a social problem to its causes, proposals and possible limits. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: The causal and concessional connectors organize a reasoning; the conditional can present prudent proposals. In this fragment, «déchets» means «waste».
